task: Add the first runtime slice of the claim-admissibility adapter-pack framework: a typed pack contract and read-only pack registry.
outcome: After running npm --prefix packages/main run test:claim-admissibility-pack-framework, the terminal prints pack contract exposes code-runtime pack, duplicate pack ids: BLOCK, duplicate artifact aliases: BLOCK, compat entrypoint exports pack registry, and ends with claim-admissibility pack framework smoke passed.
facts: The existing proof-admissibility base already owns proof vocabulary, surface definitions, evaluator behavior, and gate-facing diagnostics.
The framework document defines M1 as a typed ClaimAdmissibilityPack interface plus a registry that lists, validates, and exposes enabled packs.
Quantum and PINN domain packs are future extensions and must not be implemented in this story.
The built-in code-runtime pack can be represented from existing proof surface definitions without adding storage or lifecycle execution behavior.
constraints: Do not create a second proof manager, storage root, ledger, or lifecycle gate stack.
Do not edit story or fixture JSON directly.
Keep packs read-only and declarative in this milestone.
Do not expose productionDone, scientific truth, hardware validation, solver improvement, or Authority claims from packs.
unknowns: Whether future pack manifests will come from config or code remains open and is not solved in this story.
Whether domain schemas are JSON Schema or TypeScript-first remains deferred to M2.
Whether verifier adapters execute commands or normalize existing receipts remains deferred to M3.
